items.statement: IEA's central projection has global data-center electricity consumption rising from 485 TWh in 2025 to 950 TWh in 2030, while consumption from AI-focused data centers triples.
items.notes: Projection, not observed consumption; IEA says bottlenecks reduce the likelihood of more aggressive near-term scenarios.

items.statement: Berkeley Lab's 2025 update estimates a 2030 U.S. reference case of 649 TWh and a compounded uncertainty range of 521–843 TWh, equal to 9.5%–15.3% of U.S. electricity use.
items.notes: Scenario range derived from a bottom-up model; it should not be presented as a single certain outcome.
